name: FAST: FAST Connect ADA Paratransit
description: Paratransit rides in the Fairfield and Suisun City area
fullDescription: FAST Connect ADA (formerly DART) is Fairfield and Suisun Transit's ADA paratransit service for people who cannot use FAST local buses due to a disability. It runs within 3/4 mile of FAST local routes in the Fairfield area, during the same days and hours as the buses.
whatTheyOffer:
- Origin-to-destination shared ride service (door-to-door on request)
- Service within the City of Fairfield ADA zone, within 3/4 mile of FAST local routes
- Trips booked 1-7 days in advance; same-day only if space is available
- 10-Ride pass for $40; single rides also sold through the Token Transit app
- Wheelchair accessible vehicles
- One personal care attendant rides free
howToGetIt:
1. Call the Solano County Paratransit Eligibility Center at 707-541-7184 for an assessment
2. Complete the ADA eligibility assessment
3. Once certified, call FAST Connect ADA to book (8 am-5 pm, Monday-Saturday); dispatch is 707-422-2877 and FAST's office is 707-434-3800
